text: The proposed update changes a cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. The broader pro-action interpretation is that the result supports deployment; more precisely, the evidence supports a limited experiment but does not support broad rollout. Here is the bounded contrast: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence, and that limitation blocks only the broader action. It does not alter the exact positive evaluation: the reduction in origin requests is operationally promising. Approve only a canary deployment and require stale-read telemetry before broader rollout.
